scope: Explicit full-group Finish/actor Apply and durable readback exposed through IPC/actual CLI for Screen and FanAndLighting. Public reapply/GUI, failed-target-asset cleanup and extended lifecycle/workload qualification remain open.

contract.admission: Finish only after validated Prepared; entry permit and two Finish jobs, sharing existing theme_jobs runtime admission with ordinary LCD work. Fail-fast runtime admission before mutation. Accepted Finish owns work after RPC disconnect; Importing Cancel/Release return state without cancelling.
contract.identity: Per-device owner receipt lookup before target asset publication or LCD ticket. Repeated id verifies group/source digest/original expected and observes current desired/runtime without Apply. New work revalidates source digest/group after target codec preparation; pins retained through actor transaction.
contract.apply: Screen gets preparation ticket before slow work and reserved channel slot before target/runtime preparation; late LCD edits reject old ticket. FanAndLighting uses existing coordinator barriers, durable commit, both install ACKs then Apply. No direct IPC storage mutations or HID writes.
contract.outcome: Imported + typed FullGroupCommit published atomically only after actor result and raw staging close. Known Apply errors remain separate in runtime, do not imply storage rollback. Failed on known invalid/rejected input; otherwise RecoveryRequired, requires durable readback/recovery. No automatic reapply after readback or repeat. Cleanup/panic monitor owns resources through terminal metadata.
contract.readback: read_group_import(device,group,operation_id) through settings owner and current actor state after release/restart. Last64 durable receipts, wrong kind/missing receipt rejected. selected_content_current and current summary expose later saved edits. Runtime and storage readback are separate observations, not a jointly atomic snapshot. LCD recovery_required is null/unknown; coordinator exposes its actual bool.
contract.cli: profiles group import screen|fan-and-lighting FILE [--device], profiles group readback GROUP OPERATION_ID [--device]. Import uses bounded upload/Inspect, Finish then metadata polling. ID printed before transfer; interruption after admission cannot cancel accepted transaction. JSON preserves receipt/runtime distinction; known runtime error yields nonzero status after result output.

regressions.coverage: Actual private Unix RPC/DeviceManager/MockBackend. Full FanAndLighting import of manual fan0/motherboard pump0 and static red/blue RGB, preserved neighboring LCD, exactly two new PWM writes and Base applied states; client disconnect after acceptance. Later fan67 -> repeat returns current summary/selected=false with no new PWM. Release keeps receipt, wrong-kind readback rejected. Screen brightness75/rotation90/static JPEG theme imports, stale target after brightness52 rejects with no extra receipt and retains newer LCD intent. Fresh daemon/store with lost sessions reads both durable receipts/current fan67.

Gated admitted tasks: dropped responses, Cancel/Release cannot cancel Importing or free capacity; third Finish rejected while two jobs live; repeat cannot invoke another callback. Unknown outcome -> RecoveryRequired; known rejection -> Failed after real completion. This is admission evidence, not storage/Apply evidence.

Extended real lconnectctl/private socket flow imports full Screen archive >1MiB with sparse indexed-video slot2 and gallery-only image, explicit readback after transfer metadata release, then full fan/pump0; two receipts. Existing backup/Inspect/no-overwrite paths still pass.

checks.gui: NOT RUN; no browser/native or frontend change
checks.hardware: NOT RUN; user deferred, private stores and MockBackend only

remaining: Scoped rollback/GC: target assets are published before runtime preflight/commit, so failed Finish can leave unused uploads visible in legacy shared catalog; source-derived risk, not qualified by this checkpoint

Public raw streaming-media Finish, Apply failures/unknown/partial installation, production detach/sleep/contended/shutdown and shared budget fault matrix
Native portals/accessibility and physical qualification deferred; Windows ZIP mapping and remaining basic parity roadmap
